_comment: The Hearth's chamber beneath the Mirror Pond, for StructureBuilder. Local metres; y=0 is the pond BASIN FLOOR (world -11.375, measured: tests/test_hearth_mouth.gd fails if the heightfield moves it), +Z is the shore side the Wick walks in from. The scene is placed at the pond centre in scenes/levels/vale.tscn; the whole footprint stays inside the pond's 42 m radius and under the basin floor except the pieces listed as deliberately proud (shaft lips, kerb, gate posts, the seal). The Hearth itself is a node in scenes/structures/hearth_chamber.tscn and must match the plinth and bowl here.
_comment_mouth: THE POND MOUTH. The terrain hole in data/areas/vale.json is cut per 2 m cell, so [-4,-5,8,10] snaps outwards to local x -4..4, z -6..6 (D-014). The water has no collision, so until the pond drains this hole is a pit the player can walk into from the basin floor. Everything inside it that is not the stair opening is floored by the four apron slabs (tops at -0.05, a hair under the basin floor so their overhang cannot z-fight the terrain, and inside the 0.4 m step-up); the stair opening itself (x -1.5..1.5, z -3.5..3.5) is capped by pond_seal, which scenes/structures/hearth_chamber.gd removes once pond_drained is set. tests/test_hearth_mouth.gd walks a 0.2 m grid over the snapped hole and fails if apron + seal ever stop covering it.
name: hearth_chamber

pieces._comment: The pond seal: a stone lid over the stair opening, 0.25 m proud of the basin so it reads as a slab and is still inside the step-up. Removed by the chamber script when pond_drained is set; present until then, and absent from the first frame of a drained save.
pieces.name: pond_seal

pieces._comment: Rise 4.95, not 5: the flight tops out at -0.05, flush with the apron and landing, so the lid can sit on it. Twenty 0.2475 m risers over a 7 m run; 3 m wide so it fills the shaft wall to wall (D-014: no slot down either side).
pieces.name: hearth_stairs

pieces._comment: Shaft walls run from the chamber floor to 0.4 above the basin: the part above the apron is the lip either side of the open stairwell.
pieces.name: shaft_w

pieces._comment: The doorway is the full shaft width and 4 m tall: the stair foot lands against this wall's outer face and walks straight through.
pieces.name: chamber_wall_s

pieces._comment: Top at -0.5: the terrain over the chamber was sampled at local -0.073..+0.007, so the ceiling never breaks the basin floor and the player never looks up into the underside of the terrain.
pieces.name: chamber_ceiling

pieces._comment: Two 0.3 m tiers, each inside the step-up, so the plinth is climbed without stairs.
pieces.name: hearth_plinth_lower

pieces._comment: The fire bowl: a flared drum, rim at -3.6. The Hearth node in the scene sits on this rim.
pieces.name: hearth_bowl
